name: I Want To Be A Circle When I Grow Up.
source:
Discuss your dreams of circularity with your non-circular friend.

A short story after which an amazing machine unlocks?!

[From [url=https://littlerat.itch.io/i-want-to-be-a-circle-when-i-grow-up]Itch.io[/url]]
